description: This Java class 'BinaryDictionaryResourceNormalizer' handles the compression of word lists and their frequencies into a tree-structured binary dictionary, including splitting large files into chunks and generating associated XML resource files.

classes.name: BinaryDictionaryResourceNormalizer
classes.description: A class responsible for normalizing and splitting a binary dictionary resource into manageable chunks and generating corresponding XML resource entries.

methods.name: writeDictionaryIdsResource
methods.description: Initiates the process of splitting the output file into chunks and generating resource entries.

methods.name: splitOutputFile
methods.description: Splits the temporary output file into multiple dictionary chunk files, updates XML resource entries, and manages file streams.
